source_refs.note: Brittle Substance: a main subheading of 5.5 Elastic deformation, plastic deformation and elastic limit, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 98-99.

blocks.text: Jo cheezein elastic limit par pohanchte hi toot jati hain unhen brittle (bhurbhuri) substances kehte hain, maslan glass aur high carbon steel. Beryllium, bismuth aur chromium bhi brittle metals hain.

blocks.title: Example 5.1
blocks.problem: 12 mm diameter wali steel ki wire ek log (lakri ka mota tukra) se bandhi hai aur tractor use kheenchta hai. Log aur tractor ke beech wire ki lambai 11 m hai. Log kheenchne ke liye 10,000 N force chahiye. Wire mein stress nikalein.
steps: Diameter 12 mm hai, to radius r = 6 mm = 6 × 10⁻³ m. Area A = πr² = 3.14 × (6 × 10⁻³ m)² = 1.13 × 10⁻⁴ m².
Tensile stress σ = F/A = 10,000 N / (3.14 × (6 × 10⁻³ m)²)
Wire ki lambai (11 m) stress nikalne mein kaam nahi aati; stress sirf force aur area par depend karta hai.

blocks.title: Brain Teaser!
blocks.text: Bhari steel ka bana jahaz pani par kyun tairta hai, jab ke chhota sa patthar doob jata hai?

blocks.prompt: Brain Teaser ka jawab: bhari steel ka jahaz kyun tairta hai jab ke chhota patthar doob jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Jahaz andar se khokhla (hollow) hai, is liye woh bohat sara pani hata (displace kar) sakta hai. Archimedes ke principle (5.7) ke mutabiq upthrust hataye gaye pani ke weight ke barabar hai; jahaz poora doobne se pehle apne weight ke barabar pani hata deta hai, is liye tairta hai. Chhota patthar solid hai; jo pani woh hatata hai us ka weight patthar ke weight se kam hai, is liye doob jata hai.

blocks.caption: Stress-strain curve ke points
rows: Hooke's law: strain stress ke proportional; A = proportional limit σₚ
elastic hai magar proportional nahi; B = yield point, elastic limit σₑ
plastic: hamesha ki deformation; C = ultimate tensile strength σᵤ
toot jana (fracture), fracture stress σf par

blocks.prompt: Stress-strain curve ka kaun sa hissa Hooke's law par chalta hai? Chhoti deformation mein stress/strain ki ratio constant rehti hai; bohat bari deformation mein is ratio ka kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Hissa OA (proportional limit tak). A ke baad curve mur jata hai, is liye ratio constant nahi rehti: A aur B ke beech material elastic hai magar ratio kam hoti jati hai, aur yield point B ke baad thore se zyada stress se strain bohat barhta hai, is liye ratio tootne tak tezi se girti hai.

items: Ductile material ka curve: OA seedha (Hooke's law, proportional limit σₚ); OB elastic (B = yield point, elastic limit σₑ); BC plastic, C = UTS σᵤ; D = fracture.
Ductile: tootne se pehle plastic deformation (lead, copper, wrought iron). Brittle: elastic limit par hi toot jati hai (glass, high carbon steel, Be, Bi, Cr).
Example 5.1: σ = F/A = 88.46 × 10⁶ N m⁻² = 88.46 MPa.
